service.name: Wedding music in Fort Collins
service.serviceType: Live music for weddings in Fort Collins: ceremony guitarist, cocktail hour duo, band and DJ
service.description: Live wedding music in Fort Collins and northern Colorado: an acoustic, jazz or Spanish guitarist for a ceremony in the foothills, on a ranch or in the Poudre canyon, a jazz or acoustic duo for an Old Town cocktail hour, a band or the DJ for a ballroom or barn reception, on one contract with sound included and one flat Front Range travel line.

faqs.q: Do you play weddings in Fort Collins?
faqs.a: Yes, the whole day or any one part of it. Fort Collins is about an hour up I-25 from Denver, so the music is quoted at the same fee a Denver wedding sees plus one flat Front Range travel line, with no lodging. The Elizabeth Hotel and the Armstrong Hotel in Old Town, Block One on Linden Street, the Lincoln Center, Tapestry House west of town and Windsong Estate out on the plains are the venues that come up most.

faqs.q: What does the Fort Collins travel line cover?
faqs.a: The drive up I-25 and back for the musicians and the gear, as one flat line on the quote, the same line a Colorado Springs or Boulder date carries. There's no mileage arithmetic and no night's lodging, which the far resorts do carry. A ceremony up the Poudre canyon adds the canyon road to the plan rather than to the price, and we leave early for it.

faqs.q: Can a band play an outdoor wedding in the foothills or the canyon?
faqs.a: Yes, with the wind in the plan. The plains east of town and the foothills west of it both get an afternoon wind and a fast afternoon storm, so an outdoor ceremony or reception needs a covered, level and dry performance area with power run to it, and a ranch without a circuit near the site needs a generator, which the outdoor reception guide covers. A ceremony beside the river needs a small system that carries the vows over the water, and a guitarist with that system is the size that does it.

faqs.q: Is a duo enough for a taproom or courtyard reception in Old Town?
faqs.a: For the cocktail hour and dinner, yes: a jazz or acoustic duo at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, in 8 by 6 feet on one circuit, is the size an Old Town courtyard or a taproom's event space books. When the same night wants a floor, a trio fills one without a stage and the DJ takes the same sound system when the band is done.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book wedding musicians in Fort Collins?
faqs.a: The Old Town hotels and the ranch venues book their summer and fall Saturdays a year or more out, and the university's calendar fills the hotels on some weekends, so the venue and the date are settled first and the music comes right after. Tell us the date and we'll come back quickly with an answer and a price for that day.
